integrity: The equilibrium elimination, parameter bijection, characteristic polynomial, Routh count, and no-imaginary-axis-crossing argument were reconstructed from the printed vector field and replayed by the bundled symbolic checker.
scientific_limitations: The result is local to equilibrium geometry and linear stability; it does not establish or refute the existence of the numerically displayed periodic or chaotic invariant sets.
The numerical spectrum replay at one source parameter is illustrative only; the universal instability theorem is proved analytically.
Literature and semantic-database searches reduce but cannot eliminate the risk of an unindexed prior correction of the same equilibrium calculation.
title: Exact equilibrium threshold and universal instability in a symmetric cubic chaotic flow
